name: ASPERA
intro: ASPERA 通过开发者与 LLM 交互生成用户查询、参考动作执行程序（AEP）、状态初始化程序（SIP）和断言式评测程序（EP）。Asper-Bench 含 250 个经人工执行和修订的任务，用于测试模型在自定义助理库上合成可正确执行程序的能力。
build_method: 人机交互式LLM程序生成, 动态模拟, 人工执行与修订
metric: 任务成功率（无错误执行且全部EP断言通过）, 原语选择微平均F1
eval_feature: 可执行程序, 功能断言, CCK/原语选择设置, 模拟状态副作用
scale: 250个任务（71个信息查询、179个状态修改），7个数据库、69个原语
build_method_en: Interactive human-LLM program generation, dynamic simulation, human execution and correction
eval_feature_en: Executable programs, functional assertions, CCK/primitive-selection settings, simulated state effects
intro_en: ASPERA uses developer-LLM interaction to generate a user query, reference Action Execution Program (AEP), State Initialization Program (SIP), and assertion-based Evaluation Program (EP). Asper-Bench contains 250 human-executed and corrected tasks that test program synthesis over a custom assistant library.
scale_en: 250 tasks (71 information-seeking, 179 state-mutating) over 7 databases and 69 primitives
metric_en: Task success rate (error-free execution and all EP assertions pass), primitive-selection micro F1
drawio_review_note: PASS reviewed against arXiv:2507.15501v1 Sections 2-6 and official apple/ml-aspera snapshot 6807429bc757471d9c240ab51f97d62251886798. The workflow preserves query history, the 7-database/69-primitive library, five in-context examples for each program type, and developer execution/editing at the AEP, SIP, and EP stages. Before the 250-task release, the lead author executes and corrects all parts and two annotators independently confirm them; evaluation retains CCK, primitive selection, and the all-assertions success rule.
